final: WITH g AS (SELECT p.SEX AS sex, AVG(CAST(l.CPK AS REAL)/l.GPT) AS a FROM Laboratory l JOIN Patient p ON p.ID=l.ID WHERE p.SEX IS NOT NULL AND p.SEX<>'' AND l.CPK IS NOT NULL AND l.GPT IS NOT NULL AND l.GPT<>0 GROUP BY p.SEX), m1 AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS m FROM g), k1 AS (SELECT g.sex, g.a FROM g, m1 WHERE g.a>m1.m), m2 AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS m FROM k1), k2 AS (SELECT k1.sex, k1.a FROM k1, m2 WHERE k1.a>m2.m) SELECT AVG(k2.a) AS avg_ratio, AVG(k2.a-m1.m) AS avg_excess_m1, AVG(k2.a-m2.m) AS avg_excess_m2 FROM k2, m1, m2
